theme: Make commercial meaning credible and movable: authority earns deference, character becomes text, positions become leadership, desire gains identification, strategy fits the market, growth removes activation friction, and the customer gets a story-shaped first step.

days.fundamental: Persuasion: understand why credible expertise, titles, symbols, and evidence can serve as judgment shortcuts, and test whether the authority cue is relevant rather than merely impressive.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. Canon history has used Cialdini Chapters 1-5 and 7, but not Chapter 6; canon prep should verify the chapter boundary before assignment.

days.work: Story: Substance, Structure, Style, and the Principles of Screenwriting
days.fundamental: Storytelling: distinguish the written surface from the deeper structure of action and meaning, then make every spoken or written line carry a change in value, intention, or relationship.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. Canon history reaches McKee Chapter 11, "Character," but not Chapter 12; canon prep must bound the scanned PDF to the verified chapter stop point.

days.work: Positioning: The Battle for Your Mind
days.fundamental: Positioning/brand: learn how a leader protects the category position it already occupies, using the strength of leadership without confusing size with permanent preference.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. Canon history reaches Positioning Chapter 5, "You Can't Get There from Here"; Chapter 6 is the next non-repeated section and its source title is confirmed in the local edition.

days.chapter_or_section: Part I, Chapter 5, "The Power of Identification"
days.fundamental: Human desire/psychology: make a promise believable by giving the prospect a self-image, situation, or identity to recognize, so desire becomes personally owned rather than merely described.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. Canon history has used Breakthrough Advertising Chapters 1-4, including "38 Ways to Strengthen Your Headline Once You Have Your Basic Idea"; Chapter 5 is the next bounded, non-repeated reading.

days.chapter_or_section: Chapter 6, "Match the Size of the Organization to the Size of the Market"
days.fundamental: Tech/strategy: match an emerging market’s growth rate and uncertainty to an organization that can learn fast enough, instead of asking a large incumbent to manage a small market with the wrong incentives.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. Canon history reaches Christensen Chapter 5; Chapter 6 is the next non-repeated strategy chapter, and canon prep must parser-preflight the scanned PDF and assign a bounded section under 60 pages.

days.fundamental: Distribution/growth: turn acquisition into value by finding the first meaningful user experience, removing friction before it, and testing the path to the product’s activation moment.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. Canon history reaches Chapter Five, "Hacking Acquisition"; the EPUB table of contents confirms Chapter Six, "Hacking Activation," as the next bounded playbook chapter.

days.fundamental: Writing/taste: put the customer’s desire at the center of the message, then let the brand function as a clear guide rather than competing with the customer for the hero role.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. Canon history used StoryBrand Chapters 1-3, so Chapter 4 is a distinct next reading; the local EPUB table of contents confirms the title and sequence.
